items.title: I'm done with terminals
items.summary:
I've lived in terminals since I was 13, so this breaks my heart, but the Terminal experience isn't good for coding with agents so we need to find another solution 

Thank you Blacksmith for sponsoring! Check them out at: https://soydev.link/blacksmith

Want to sponsor a video? Learn more here: https://soydev.link/sponsor-me

Check out my Twitch, Twitter, Discord more at https://t3.gg

S/O @Ph4seon3 for the awesome edit 🙏
